name: Euretta Seejungfrau
original_name: エウレッタ・ゼーユングフラウ
source: A priestess with extensive powers who carries out special duties of the religious community named Ordinis. Euretta's reasons for joining a group of heroes are as mysterious as her own personality. She persistently avoids any friendly relationships with Caro and others. She keeps a low profile and hardly talks. But once she secludes herself, she uncovers the hidden features of her character. She's kind to children and loves the nature. Euretta's magical abilities are always helps to treat the wounded warriors and eliminate the evil creatures. So, why is she avoids people? What else terrible secrets she's hiding?
